relationships.subject: clonidine
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, the preinjection of clonidine (25 nmol) significantly shortened the total time of capsaicin-evoked nociceptive behaviors, indicating that clonidine inhibited capsaicin-induced pain (Fig. 1D).

relationships.subject: noradrenaline
relationships.evidence_quote: significantly extended the total time of nociceptive behaviors, indicating that NA enhanced capsaicin-induced pain (Fig. 1B)

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: On the other hand, paw withdrawal latency increased when capsazepine (5 nmol) was preinjected

key_findings: Peripheral clonidine inhibited capsaicin-evoked and heat nociception through local alpha2 receptors; yohimbine blocked the effect.
alpha2C mRNA was most abundant in DRG, and alpha2A/alpha2C immunoreactivity colocalized with TRPV1 in small and medium neurons.
